name: Count transactions in time range
sql_template:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.transaction_facts`(DATE '{start_date}', DATE '{end_date}')
nl_seed: How many transactions happened between {start_date} and {end_date}?

validation.scope_note: One-day bounded transaction aggregate.

name: List transactions from an account
sql_template:
SELECT transaction_hash, block_timestamp, to_address, value_wei
FROM `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.labeled_transactions`(DATE '{start_date}', DATE '{end_date}')
WHERE from_address = '{account}'
ORDER BY block_timestamp DESC
LIMIT {n}
nl_seed: List {n} transactions sent by {account} between {start_date} and {end_date}.

validation.scope_note: Known Binance treasury sender.

name: Token transfer after native funding
sql_template:
WITH funding AS (
  SELECT transaction_hash, block_timestamp, from_address, to_address
  FROM `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.labeled_transactions`(DATE '{start_date}', DATE '{end_date}')
  WHERE to_address IS NOT NULL AND from_address_role = 'treasury'
), transfers AS (
  SELECT transaction_hash, log_index, block_timestamp, from_address, to_address, token_symbol, normalized_amount
  FROM `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.labeled_token_transfers`(DATE '{start_date}', DATE '{end_date}')
)
SELECT funding.transaction_hash AS funding_hash, transfers.transaction_hash AS transfer_hash, transfers.log_index, funding.to_address AS funded_address, transfers.token_symbol, transfers.normalized_amount
FROM funding
JOIN transfers ON transfers.from_address = funding.to_address
  AND transfers.block_timestamp >= funding.block_timestamp
  AND transfers.block_timestamp < TIMESTAMP_ADD(funding.block_timestamp, INTERVAL {duration_minutes} MINUTE)
ORDER BY transfers.block_timestamp
LIMIT {n}
nl_seed: Find {n} token transfers within {duration_minutes} minutes after exchange funding from {start_date} to {end_date}.

validation.scope_note: Bounded temporal join may be empty for a one-day sample.

name: Native flow between exchange treasuries
sql_template:
SELECT transaction_hash, block_timestamp, from_owner, to_owner, value_wei
FROM `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.labeled_transactions`(DATE '{start_date}', DATE '{end_date}')
WHERE from_address_role = 'treasury'
  AND to_address_role = 'treasury'
  AND from_owner != to_owner
ORDER BY value_wei DESC
LIMIT {n}
nl_seed: Show {n} native transactions between different exchange owners from {start_date} to {end_date}.

validation.scope_note: Only known treasury addresses; one-day direct flow may be empty.

name: Bridge outflow after exchange deposit
sql_template:
WITH deposits AS (
  SELECT transaction_hash, block_timestamp, from_owner, to_address
  FROM `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.labeled_transactions`(DATE '{start_date}', DATE '{end_date}')
  WHERE from_address_role = 'treasury'
    AND to_address_role = 'operational'
    AND to_concept_class = 'BridgeProtocol'
), outflows AS (
  SELECT transaction_hash, log_index, block_timestamp, from_address, to_address, token_symbol, normalized_amount
  FROM `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.labeled_token_transfers`(DATE '{start_date}', DATE '{end_date}')
)
SELECT deposits.transaction_hash AS deposit_hash, outflows.transaction_hash AS transfer_hash, outflows.log_index, deposits.from_owner AS exchange_owner, deposits.to_address AS bridge_address, outflows.token_symbol, outflows.normalized_amount
FROM deposits
JOIN outflows ON outflows.from_address = deposits.to_address
  AND outflows.block_timestamp >= deposits.block_timestamp
  AND outflows.block_timestamp < TIMESTAMP_ADD(deposits.block_timestamp, INTERVAL {duration_minutes} MINUTE)
ORDER BY outflows.block_timestamp
LIMIT {n}
nl_seed: Find {n} bridge outflows within {duration_minutes} minutes after exchange deposits from {start_date} to {end_date}.

validation.scope_note: Bounded bridge pattern depends on limited operational coverage.

name: Repeated transaction pairs
sql_template:
SELECT from_address, to_address, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, SUM(value_wei) AS total_value_wei
FROM `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.transaction_facts`(DATE '{start_date}', DATE '{end_date}')
WHERE to_address IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY from_address, to_address
HAVING transaction_count > 1
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, total_value_wei DESC
LIMIT {n}
nl_seed: Which {n} address pairs repeated transactions most often between {start_date} and {end_date}?

validation.scope_note: Direct repeated pairs; no unsupported actor identity inferred.
